senses.gloss:
N. of a lunar month in which the full moon stands in the constellation ज्येष्ठा (corresponding to May-June). 
-ष्ठी 
__1 The full-moon day in the month of ज्यैष्ठ. 
__2 A small house-lizard.
a. Born from the eldest or principal wife; कृते कनिष्ठिनेयस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयं विवासितम् [[Bk. 5. 84.]]

__1 Precedence, priority of birth, primogeniture, seniority. 
__2 Pre-eminence, sovereignty.
